note: Pets wearing each accessory (fitted renders) for the lotus prototype, 18 Oct 2026. Test folder only.

assets.subject: Mochi, the pet shown in the second reference image (a small round cream bunny with lavender ears and a violet lotus on its collar), wearing the white chef hat with a small purple lotus badge shown in the third reference image
assets.details: Keep Mochi exactly the same character: same body, colours, face, expression and pose as the second reference image. The accessory sits snugly on top of its head, sized to its head and tilted slightly, with a soft contact shadow where it touches; its ears or cap stay natural around it. It must look truly worn, with correct size, overlap and shading, not pasted on. Only one accessory on the pet.
